homepage_uptime_failure.title: Site unreachable
homepage_uptime_failure.action: Check the service's status and serving revision, then its request log. Revert the last deploy if it started there.

capture_job_heartbeat.title: Capture job has stopped running
capture_job_heartbeat.action: Check the job's executions and whether its scheduler job is paused, then run the job by hand to see the failure.

request_5xx.title: Request failed with ${metric.label.response_code}
request_5xx.action: Read the request log for the URL and traceback. This is a defect.

application_errors.title: Application error
application_errors.action: Read the matched entry and fix the defect it names. A feed's failed update never reaches this policy.

plot_generation_failure.title: Plot failed: ${metric.label.location} ${metric.label.feed}
plot_generation_failure.action: Read the plot event. The last good plot stays up; a failure that repeats for one location is a defect in that plot's data handling.

snapshot_load_failures.title: Web servers cannot load the snapshot
snapshot_load_failures.action: Check the service identity's access to the bucket and that the published pointer exists. Instances keep serving the generation they have.

snapshot_load_lag.title: Web server loaded a late snapshot
snapshot_load_lag.action: One after a deploy or a cold start is expected. Repeats mean the refresh path is stuck; a new revision clears it.

archive_merge_failures.title: Archive merge failed: ${metric.label.source}
archive_merge_failures.action: A single failure against an equally recent claim recovers on the next run. Repeats mean the store or the merge path is broken.

archive_read_gap.title: Historical year missing: ${log.extracted_label.location}
archive_read_gap.action: Check the archive objects for that source. The plots show the year as a gap until it is restored.

repeated_feed_failures.title: Feed failing: ${metric.label.location} ${metric.label.feed}
repeated_feed_failures.action: Request the URL in the feed's error by hand. A timeout, refused connection, or 5xx is the provider's outage and needs nothing; a 4xx, a changed format, or a validation error is a code change. The incident closes on its own after the feed recovers.

snapshot_feed_stale.title: Feed stale: ${log.extracted_label.location} ${log.extracted_label.feed}
snapshot_feed_stale.action: Nothing while the provider is down: the site is serving the feed's last good frame. Act only if the outage outlasts the carried predictions.

live_feed_update_latency.title: Live feed slow: ${metric.label.location}
live_feed_update_latency.action: Nothing unless it lasts days; the fetches are succeeding. Then look at the provider's response times.

live_plot_availability_latency.title: Live plots slow: ${log.extracted_label.location}
live_plot_availability_latency.action: A single run is noise. Every run means the process pool is starved, which is a defect.
